_comment: Devin Desktop/CLI, HTTP variant. Variant A (primary, per-user): put YOUR OWN credentials in headers below -- either raw components (server builds KSCBasic internally, no Base64 by hand) or one verbatim X-KSC-Authorization value (format: KSCBasic user="<b64>", pass="<b64>", internal="<0|1>" with domain="<b64>" for domain users, or KSCT <token>; verbatim wins if both are set; no one-time CreateToken tokens -- 3 min, single use); server runs with KSC_PER_REQUEST_AUTH=1 (fail-closed without header). Optional extra header X-KSC-VServer with the Base64 virtual-server name. Component values must be printable ASCII (clients reject the rest); non-ASCII credentials must be pre-Base64-encoded via the verbatim variant. Variant B (fallback, service account): delete the headers block and run the server with a dedicated read-only KSC service account in its ENV (flag off). Never commit real secrets: personal values belong in user/local scope, not in shared project configs. The MCP server is intranet-only (no internet exposure).
